paper_metadata.title: Improved Compressive Properties of TiAl Alloy with Ultrafine/Fine Grains Prepared by High-Energy Ball Milling and Hot-Pressing Sintering
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb pre-alloyed powders produced by the plasma rotating electrode process (PREP), with a nominal chemical composition (wt.%) of 32.82%Al, 2.68%Cr, 4.91%Nb, 0.30%O, and bal. Ti, were used in this study as the raw material.
The milling time was 25 and 35 h, respectively, and the obtained fine powders could be expressed as 25MMed powders and 35MMed powders.

phases_and_microstructures.name: gamma-TiAl
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: sintered compact from Mixed powder (bimodal ultrafine/fine grains)

attributes.composition: Al and Ti atomic ratio close to 1:1, Nb and Cr contents obviously higher than in alpha2-Ti3Al phase

evidence.quote: The sizes of c-TiAl and a2-Ti3Al grains are in the range of 0.25/C242.25 lm and 0.25 /C241.75 lm, respectively.
In the c-TiAl phase, the atomic ratio between Al and Ti is close to 1:1, and the contents of Nb and Cr are obviously higher than that in the a2-Ti3Al phase.

phases_and_microstructures.name: alpha2-Ti3Al
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: sintered compact from Mixed powder (bimodal ultrafine/fine grains)

evidence.quote: The sizes of c-TiAl and a2-Ti3Al grains are in the range of 0.25/C242.25 lm and 0.25 /C241.75 lm, respectively. In the regions formed by 35MMed powders, the island-like grains are refined and show a tendency of interconnecting (Ref 20). The content of a2-Ti3Al phase increases to 43.3%.
For the sample from the 35MMed powders (Fig. 3c), the island-like grains disappear, and the proportion of a2-Ti3Al phase increased to 82.2%.

evidence.quote: EBSD image and TEM micrograph further confirmed the mixed bimodal structure, as shown in Fig. 4. Obviously, the fine grains are embedded in the ultrafine grains, as shown in Fig. 4(a) and (b).
The average sizes of ultrafine and fine grains are 0.35 and 0.91 lm, respectively. The volume fraction of the ultrafine grain accounts for 68.38%, while that of the fine grain accounts for 31.62%.

evidence.quote: The formation of equiaxed grains indicates that recrystallization and grain growth are the main evolution of microstructure during sintering.

On the other hand, the 35MMed compact is not a complete dense body. The existence of pores in the compact also increases the sensitivity of the ultrafine crystal structure to crack nucleation and propagation.

evidence.quote: Since a2-Ti3Al is a typical dense hexagonal crystal structure, a high shear stress is required during plastic deformation. But its independent slip system is less, so the corresponding deformation activation is difficult. Therefore, the presence of a large amount of a2-Ti3Al phase significantly reduces the plasticity of the compact prepared from 35MMed powders.
